# Johan Chereau — Portfolio

> Johan Chereau is a software, web and mobile developer based in France. He designs and builds digital products across web, mobile-oriented experiences, desktop software and professional tools, with a particular interest in EdTech and mobility.

## Main pages

- French homepage: https://johan-chereau.com/fr/
- English homepage: https://johan-chereau.com/en/
- French projects: https://johan-chereau.com/fr/projects/
- English projects: https://johan-chereau.com/en/projects/

## Featured projects

- CTCR Trainer: https://johan-chereau.com/fr/projects/ctcr-trainer/
  - EdTech web application created from a real professional training need.
  - Lessons, quizzes, training and exam modes, professional calculations.
  - Live product: https://tp-ctcr-trainer.vercel.app/
  - Source: https://github.com/JohanChereau/tp-ctcr-trainer
- Cosmify: https://johan-chereau.com/fr/projects/cosmify/
  - Desktop application for importing, understanding, editing, backing up and restoring Minecraft Bedrock packs.
  - React, TypeScript and Tauri.
  - Source: https://github.com/JohanChereau/cosmify

## Professional profile

- Main focus: product-oriented software, web and mobile development.
- Interests: EdTech, mobility, professional tools, interface design and interactive experiences.
- Professional development/product experience: SNCF, Dotscreen and Dawan.
- Additional professional qualification: professional public transport / coach driver (CTCR).
